note: Independent re-audit against RFC 9069 Section 5.1 ('Peer Autonomous System (AS): Set to the primary router BGP autonomous system number (ASN).') at HEAD. locRIBPeerHeader sets PeerAS from localIdentity() (parsed from bgp config). Positive: TestLocRIBPeerHeader pins 4-octet ASN 4200000001; TestRFC9069ReloadTurningLocRIBOnAnnouncesTheRouterIdentity commits loc-rib=true over the reload rail with an empty openCache and asserts PeerAS==4200000001 and ASN4 capability==4200000001 off the net.Pipe wire. Negative: TestLocRIBPeerHeaderCarriesTheIdentityItIsGiven passes two distinct identities (65001, 65002) and asserts distinct exact PeerAS values, catching hardcoded or zero-filled PeerAS.
